description: Renovate config for minimal-java. Extends the recommended preset; see https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/ for tuning options (auto-merge policies, schedules, grouping rules). See docs/renovate.md for how this repo's setup fits together.

packageRules.description: Major bumps land on the Dependency Dashboard as a checkbox instead of opening a PR automatically. Tick the box, run Renovate, and it opens the PR — keeps the review queue free of breaking-change PRs you didn't ask for.

Base images use ${ARG}-composed tags (eclipse-temurin:${JAVA_VERSION}-jre in the runtime Dockerfiles, ubuntu:${UBUNTU_VERSION} in images/2-size/golden-ubuntu/Dockerfile). Renovate's Docker manager can DETECT these (it resolves the ARG) but cannot rewrite the ARG-composed tag in place, so minor/patch tag PRs just fail and clutter the dashboard — disable those; a new MAJOR still surfaces on the dashboard, bump the ARG by hand. NOTE 'digest' is deliberately NOT disabled: the golden base images pin their upstream by @sha256 (e.g. FROM ubuntu:${UBUNTU_VERSION}@sha256:...), and Renovate updates a literal digest in place even with an ARG tag — so this keeps the golden pins current automatically. 'pinDigest' stays disabled so the intentionally-floating naive `fat` and throwaway `extract` stages are not auto-pinned. (chisel is unaffected: it's the custom 'regex' manager.)

customManagers.description: Track the chisel release pinned in images/2-size/golden-ubuntu/Dockerfile's CHISEL_VERSION ARG. chisel is fetched from a GitHub release URL (not referenced as an image tag), so the Docker manager can't see it — the `# renovate:` annotation above the ARG plus this regex manager edit that ARG line directly. The managerFilePatterns regex matches any path ending in Dockerfile, so images/*/Dockerfile is covered. Unlike the ubuntu/temurin base images (whose ${ARG}-composed tags the Docker manager can detect but not rewrite), chisel updates apply cleanly because the version IS the whole ARG value.
